start: Admin app, owner of a single gym, Branches

user_sees: The business name = the gym name; one branch; canOpen true
must_not: A desk person told they can add branches

steps.action: Add a branch 'Andheri' with 'copy plans' on (owner_add_branch)
user_sees: Signed in to the new branch; receipt prefix 'B2'; plans copied count
must_not: The new branch without its owners
Receipt numbers that clash with the first branch
A copied import mark

user_sees: Signed in there with a new key
must_not: Signed in as front desk

start: Admin app, a business with branches

user_sees: The new name on every branch's list
must_not: A branch renamed instead of the business
Nothing saved

steps.action: Add a branch with an empty name, or a name already used in the business
must_not: Two branches with the same name
A branch over the limit

steps.action: Front desk or old owner key adds or opens a branch
must_not: The desk inside another branch

steps.action: Open a gym id outside the business
must_not: Another business's gym opened

start: A paused (suspended) gym and its branches

steps.action: Add a branch from a paused gym
must_not: A branch made while paused

steps.action: Open a paused branch the owner is missing from
user_sees: The owner is put on its list and signed in
must_not: A desk person added to a paused branch

start: Owner of a business with branches

user_sees: Only this business's branches: name, join code, receipt prefix
must_not: Another business's branches
Member data of other branches

user_sees: Its trial ends when the first branch's does, on the same plan
must_not: A fresh 3-month trial per new branch

steps.action: Open the list of business groups (hq_groups)
user_sees: Each group: name, branches in order, status, register and app member counts
must_not: A gym in no group listed as a group

steps.action: Look at the HQ audit log
user_sees: One 'view_groups' row with the number of groups
must_not: The look not written down

start: A caller that is not HQ

steps.action: Call hq_groups with the anon key
must_not: Any business's branches or member counts returned

start: A group that gets a new branch

steps.action: Open Groups before and after the owner adds a branch
user_sees: The new branch listed with its prefix and status
must_not: The new branch missing until a reload of HQ data

user_sees: Counts only; no member names or phones
must_not: A member's name or phone shown without a support window
